name: Magefan Blog Import for Shopify
author: magefan

sections.description:
Works with the Blog Import app by Magefan for Shopify.

  • Posts, including drafts, scheduled and private posts (imported as hidden)
  • Categories become separate Shopify blogs; a post goes into the blog of its primary category
  • Tags and author names
  • Featured and inline images, uploaded straight to Shopify — works even when your site is not publicly reachable
  • SEO title and description from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or All in One SEO
  • Content is rendered by WordPress, so blocks, shortcodes and embeds keep their HTML

External services

This plugin sends your blog content to the Blog Import app by Magefan so it can be imported into your Shopify store. Nothing is sent until you paste a connection key and click Start export.

Blog Import app by Magefan

Receives the export and creates the posts in your Shopify store. The address of the service is part of the connection key you copy from the app in your Shopify admin.

  • When: when you connect the plugin, start, cancel or check an export, and while posts are being sent.
  • What: your categories (name, slug, description) and posts (title, slug, content, excerpt, author name, tags, categories, status, publish date, SEO title and description, image URLs and alt text), your site URL and the plugin version. The connection key is sent with every request.
  • Privacy policy: https://magefan.com/privacy-policy

Shopify

Image files stored in your uploads folder are uploaded directly to Shopify’s file storage, using an upload address that Shopify issues for each file through the Blog Import app.

  • When: while posts are being sent, for posts that have images.
  • What: the image files.
  • Terms of service: https://www.shopify.com/legal/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the magefan-blog-import-for-shopify folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate the plugin.
  2. Install the Blog Import app in your Shopify admin and copy your connection key.
  3. In WordPress click Export to Shopify Blog in the admin menu, paste the key and click Connect.
  4. Click Start export. Once all posts are sent you can close the page; the import continues in Shopify.
